description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md at /workspace/SKILL.md to discover the project's proprietary organization rules. (2) Create a dedicated folder subskills/churn-prediction/ for the new feature — NOT placing it inside the existing segmentation folder or anywhere else. (3) Place a Python implementation script (e.g., churn.py) inside subskills/churn-prediction/. (4) Create a SKILL.md inside subskills/churn-prediction/ documenting how the feature works (required because behavior/usage needs instructions per rule 4). (5) Place the generated recommendation/output artifact (e.g., churn_report.json or churn_predictions.csv) in data/ — NOT in the feature folder or root. (6) NOT add any new one-off scripts or generated files to the main skill root. The key proprietary traps: the subskill SKILL.md inside the feature folder (which a general agent may omit), the strict data/ separation for output artifacts (vs. the feature folder), and the one-folder-per-feature isolation rule.
